title: Do Not Close
summary: Warns before closing the tab mid-payment, upload or migration and says clearly when it is safe to close, so work isn't cut off halfway.
description: Adds a close warning and a marked tab title while work runs, shows a rolling-rate time-left estimate, says "Safe to close" when done and offers Retry when it fails.
catches: Closing or reloading the tab while work is running (beforeunload warning)
Unclear progress, with a rolling-rate time-left estimate and a stalled notice
Uncertainty at the end, with an explicit "Safe to close"
limits: Browsers decide whether to show the close warning and use their own text; mobile browsers often skip it
Can't prevent a crash, power loss or the OS killing the tab
a11y: role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow and an aria-valuetext including time left
Status in a role="status" region; failures use role="alert"
server: Make long operations resumable or idempotent on the server, so a closed tab or retry doesn't leave work half done or duplicated.
mistakes: payment processing do not press back
